procedure: Header stacks and cell values read from page renders (page.crop().to_image), 800-1300 dpi zooms per cell cluster, saved under cache/2026-general-text/header-strips/ (jas_*). Labels read left-to-right per page; every candidate's cells verified against the printed county TOTAL. Whole-grid render pass (2026-11-19, the operator_rows conversion): p2/p3 and p4/p5 row strips re-rendered at 600 dpi (cache/2026-general-text/operator-verify/jasper/jas_p2_<candidate>_{a,b,c}.png, jas_p3_<candidate>_t.png, jas_p4_sorey_{a,b,c}.png, jas_p5_sorey_t.png; full pages jas_p2_full300.png .. jas_p5_full300.png), each of the 11 rows' 13 cells cross-page sum checked against its printed county TOTAL (p3/p5 TOTAL column): 11/11 reconcile after the adjudicated Sullivan correction below.
extraction_note: The OCR text layer is unusable for the grid across BOTH column groups. p4/p5 parse nothing at any floor (p4's numeric clusters are 1-2 members each, 17 clean tokens on the whole page among 11 columns; p5's first min_columns=2 line is the Circuit Court office header itself, y=170.6 -- a false top above the data); p2/p3 parse rows and columns (the widened three-data-line anchor recovers p2's 11 real columns c285..c738 and the declared page_min_columns floor of 2 reached p3's true first data line) but their digit tokens are corrupt beyond token repair and still read as clean numbers (the layer drops whole cells; print 864 decodes '8', 109 decodes '101', 164 decodes '764', 4970 decodes '497'), so per-candidate runs cannot be certified from the layer (58 gate problems; cache/2026-general-text/jasper_run_phaseD.txt). p2-p5 are therefore all declared operator_supply_pages -- the layer parse is not used at all -- and the whole grid arrives through the operator_rows entries below, keyed on these declared labels; the county parses with an empty layer table-page set and the gates judge every row against its printed TOTAL.
structure_note: Column-split pagination like Warren: p2+p3 are one logical table (14 columns = 13 precincts + TOTAL; p2 = columns 1-11 Antioch..Paulding, p3 = columns 12-13 Rose Hill, Stringer + TOTAL), and p4+p5 are a SECOND such table for the Circuit Court 13-Place 2 section (p4 = columns 1-11, p5 = Rose Hill, Stringer + TOTAL). Each race section's row prints in full under BOTH column sets with the office headers reprinted on every page. p2's vertical name stacks print bottom-aligned (Antioch, Bay Springs Beat 3, Bay Springs Beat 4, Claiborne, Heidelberg, Holders, Louin, Montrose, Moss, Moss East, Paulding); p3/p5's tail stacks are Rose Hill, Stringer, TOTAL. p1 is the certification cover page (Official Recapitulation 2026 General Election, no table).
truncation_note: No page-edge truncations on this document: Moss East is a complete printed name visible on p2 (also p4), new vs the county's 2026 primary precinct list (20260310__ms__primary__jasper__precinct.csv, 12 precincts); every other spelling matches the primary/2024 general lists.
